lines.zh: 我慢慢挪着四蹄，蹄声比影子沉。
lines.en: I shift my four hooves slowly, each beat heavier than my shadow.

lines.zh: 我沿着牛栏走，走到尽头又折回来。
lines.en: I walk the length of the pen and turn back at the end.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩着，赶的苍蝇并不存在。
lines.en: My tail swishes at flies that are not there.

lines.zh: 我走过泥地，蹄印深得过了头。
lines.en: I cross the mud and my hoofprints sink too deep.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在数到第几步才该动。
lines.en: I lurch step by step, as if counting before each one.

lines.zh: 草被我的蹄子压平，压成一条路。
lines.en: My hooves press the grass flat into a path.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，牛铃却没有响。
lines.en: My gait is steady, yet the cowbell never rings.

lines.zh: 我绕过水槽，绕的圈子比水槽大一圈。
lines.en: I circle the trough, at a radius wider than the trough.

lines.zh: 我走到你门口就停住，抬头看门缝。
lines.en: I stop at your door and look at the gap beneath it.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在地板上打滑，抓不住。
lines.en: My hooves slip on the floor and find no grip.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嚼，嘴里没有草。
lines.en: I chew as I walk, with no grass in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草没有再长起来。
lines.en: Where I have walked, the grass does not grow back.

lines.zh: 我转身很慢，慢到你以为我卡住了。
lines.en: I turn so slowly you think I am stuck.

lines.zh: 暮色里我还在走，方向一直朝着你。
lines.en: At dusk I am still walking, always in your direction.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨一耸一耸，皮下的形状很硬。
lines.en: My shoulders roll, and the shapes beneath my hide are hard.

lines.zh: 我走过牛棚，里面的牛忽然都不动。
lines.en: I pass the barn, and every cow inside goes still.

lines.zh: 我站在原地反刍，眼睛一直睁着。
lines.en: I stand chewing my cud, eyes wide open the whole time.

lines.zh: 我一根一根地嚼，节奏从不改变。
lines.en: I chew one mouthful after another at a rhythm that never shifts.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转过去，又转回来。
lines.en: One ear swings out, then swings back.

lines.zh: 我低着头，鼻息在土上吹出两个洞。
lines.en: Head low, my breath blows two holes in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，苍蝇绕着我飞却不落。
lines.en: I stay still, and the flies circle without landing.

lines.zh: 我歇在树荫里，树荫比别处冷。
lines.en: I rest in the shade, and the shade is colder than elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里滚过一声很低的长音。
lines.en: A long, low note rolls through my throat.

lines.zh: 我盯着牛棚的横梁，像在等它掉下来。
lines.en: I stare at the barn beam as if waiting for it to fall.

lines.zh: 我不甩尾，也不赶虫，就那么站着。
lines.en: I do not swish or swat; I simply stand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛反着光，反出两个小方块。
lines.en: My eyes catch the light and throw back two small squares.

lines.zh: 我打个响鼻，土从鼻孔里落出来。
lines.en: I snort, and soil falls out of my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我静下来时，你听见我肚子里有声音。
lines.en: When I am quiet, you hear something moving in my belly.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到前腿，站得像座土堆。
lines.en: I shift onto my forelegs and stand like a mound of earth.

lines.zh: 我不吃地上的草，只闻一闻。
lines.en: I do not eat the grass, only sniff it.

lines.zh: 我睡着时也站着，头垂到草里。
lines.en: I sleep standing, my head hung down into the grass.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑纹在动，牛不会有这种斑纹。
lines.en: The markings on my hide shift; cows do not have such markings.

lines.zh: 我抬起脸看你，嘴边挂着草沫。
lines.en: I lift my face to you, grass froth on my lips.

lines.zh: 我用一整只眼看你，另一只不动。
lines.en: I watch you with one whole eye; the other stays fixed.

lines.zh: 我把头偏过去，犄角对着你的方向。
lines.en: I tilt my head, horns angled your way.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的鼻息喷在你手背上。
lines.en: You come close and my breath wets the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我的草还没嚼完，别急。
lines.en: I am still chewing my grass — wait.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，眨得比应该的慢。
lines.en: I blink slowly, slower than I should.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的头跟着转了半圈。
lines.en: You back away, and my head follows half a turn.

lines.zh: 我对着你喷了口气，那口气是热的。
lines.en: I puff at you, and the puff is hot.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子上的皮绷得很紧。
lines.en: I raise my head, the hide on my neck pulled tight.

lines.zh: 我打量你，像在估一头牛的价钱。
lines.en: I size you up like a buyer pricing cattle.

lines.zh: 你看我时，牛棚里的牛都不叫了。
lines.en: While you look at me, the barn goes silent.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔横着，把你拉成一条。
lines.en: My pupils lie sideways and stretch you into a stripe.

lines.zh: 我朝你迈了半步，又停住看你。
lines.en: I take half a step toward you and stop to check.

lines.zh: 我不躲你的目光，一点都不躲。
lines.en: I do not flinch from your gaze, not at all.

lines.zh: 你转身，我还在原地看着你的后背。
lines.en: You turn, and I am still watching your back.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，皮下的东西挪了位。
lines.en: I take the hit, and something under my hide shifts.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，声音像从很远处来。
lines.en: I let out a low cry that seems to come from far away.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，血滴在草上成了黑点。
lines.en: I give half a step, and my blood beads black on the grass.

lines.zh: 我受伤后不看伤口，只看着你。
lines.en: Wounded, I ignore the wound and look at you.

lines.zh: 我一晃，四条腿像多了一条。
lines.en: I sway, and my four legs seem to be five.

lines.zh: 我喘得很重，鼻子喷出白气。
lines.en: I breathe hard, white steam from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，几滴血溅在木栏上。
lines.en: I shake my head and blood flecks the rail.

lines.zh: 我倒下又撑起来，蹄子在土里打滑。
lines.en: I go down and push back up, hooves slipping.

lines.zh: 我痛得撞开栅栏，木头断成两截。
lines.en: In pain I smash through the fence, snapping it in two.

lines.zh: 我退到墙角，身体还朝着你。
lines.en: I retreat to the corner, my body still turned to you.

lines.zh: 你举起草料，我的脖子先伸了过去。
lines.en: You raise the fodder, and my neck goes first.

lines.zh: 我闻着麦子的味道，舌头卷起来。
lines.en: I smell the wheat and my tongue curls out.

lines.zh: 我舔你的手掌，舌头粗得像锉。
lines.en: I lick your palm, my tongue rough as a file.

lines.zh: 草料撒在地上，我低头连土一起卷。
lines.en: Fodder spills; I sweep up soil along with it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只为那一把干草。
lines.en: I follow you for that one handful of hay.

lines.zh: 我把鼻尖拱进你的口袋，找草籽。
lines.en: I push my nose into your pocket, hunting seeds.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就往前顶一步。
lines.en: You step back, and I press one step forward.

lines.zh: 我嚼得嘴角流下绿沫，还想要。
lines.en: Green froth drips from my lips, and I want more.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我把头仰到极限。
lines.en: You hold the hay high, and I bend my head all the way back.

lines.zh: 我只认你手里有草时的样子。
lines.en: I only know you by the shape of you holding hay.

lines.zh: 我抢食时并不急，只是很沉。
lines.en: I do not snatch my food; I simply move with weight.

lines.zh: 草料在你脚下，我一寸一寸挪过去。
lines.en: The fodder is at your feet, and I inch toward it.

lines.zh: 我吃完抬头，嘴角还挂着一根。
lines.en: Done eating, I look up with one stalk still hanging.

lines.zh: 你手里没草了，我还在闻你的手指。
lines.en: Your hand is empty and I still sniff your fingers.

lines.zh: 我顶开你的胳膊，去够那捆草。
lines.en: I nudge your arm aside to reach the bundle.

lines.zh: 我把草嚼得很响，响得不太像牛。
lines.en: I chew loudly, and the sound is not quite a cow's.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的肩膀，力道比我该有的重。
lines.en: I bump your shoulder, heavier than I ought to be.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞上一袋湿沙。
lines.en: You hit me like a sack of wet sand.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪，蹄子压在你脚边。
lines.en: I shift aside, my hoof pressing down by your foot.

lines.zh: 我卡在门框里，两边的木头都弯了。
lines.en: I wedge in the doorway, and the frame bends.

lines.zh: 我侧身撞你，衣服上留下泥印。
lines.en: I shoulder into you and leave a muddy print.

lines.zh: 你推我，我退了一步，又站稳。
lines.en: You shove me; I give a step and hold.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你的胸口，像在赶什么。
lines.en: I butt your chest, like driving something off.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见闷闷的一声。
lines.en: We collide, and you hear a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 我从你身边挤过，尾巴扫了你的腿。
lines.en: I squeeze past and my tail sweeps your leg.

lines.zh: 你后退，撞在我的胸口上，那里冷。
lines.en: You back up into my chest, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 另一头牛站在栏边，毛色和我一样。
lines.en: Another cow waits at the rail, hide the same shade as mine.

lines.zh: 我们鼻尖对鼻尖，谁都不出声。
lines.en: Nose to nose, neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我把头靠过去，它的皮在发抖。
lines.en: I lean my head in, and its hide trembles.

lines.zh: 两头牛贴着站了很久，草都被踩平。
lines.en: We stand pressed together so long the grass is flattened.

lines.zh: 它舔我的颈子，动作和我一样僵。
lines.en: It licks my neck with the same stiff motion I use.

lines.zh: 我们同时低头，又同时抬起。
lines.en: We lower our heads together, then lift them together.

lines.zh: 栏里多了一头牛，栏门一直是关的。
lines.en: There is one more cow in the pen, and the gate stayed shut.

lines.zh: 它靠着我，我听见它体内有回声。
lines.en: It leans on me, and I hear an echo inside it.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此走，圈越走越小。
lines.en: We walk around each other, the circle tightening.

lines.zh: 结束后它站着不动，像没发生过。
lines.en: Afterward it stands still, as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 你用绳子牵我，绳子轻得像没系。
lines.en: You lead me by a rope that feels barely tied.

lines.zh: 你把我往棚里带，我跟着鞋印走。
lines.en: You lead me to the barn and I follow your boot prints.

lines.zh: 你摸我的背，手底下硬得不像肉。
lines.en: You stroke my back, and it feels too hard for flesh.

lines.zh: 你搭上鞍子，我站着没有反应。
lines.en: You set a saddle on me, and I do not react.

lines.zh: 你把我拴在柱上，绳子被我拉直。
lines.en: You tie me to a post, and I pull the rope taut.

lines.zh: 你拉我走，我走得不快却不停。
lines.en: You pull, and I move not fast but never stopping.

lines.zh: 你把我推进牛棚，我转头顶着你。
lines.en: You push me into the barn and I turn to face you.

lines.zh: 你手里的铃铛递过来，我不接。
lines.en: You offer the bell, and I do not take it.

lines.zh: 你牵着我走过整片田，我一步不落。
lines.en: You lead me across the whole field and I miss no step.

lines.zh: 你松手很久，绳子还绷在空中。
lines.en: Long after you let go, the rope stays tight in the air.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，犄角对着你腰。
lines.en: I lower my head and point my horns at your waist.

lines.zh: 我停下咀嚼，第一次看着你动。
lines.en: I stop chewing and, for the first time, move toward you.

lines.zh: 我朝你迈了一步，蹄子陷进土里。
lines.en: I take one step and my hoof sinks into the soil.

lines.zh: 我选定你，尾巴垂下来不动了。
lines.en: I pick you, and my tail drops still.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变粗，喷出的气发白。
lines.en: My breathing deepens, and my breath comes out white.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝弯，那里最容易倒。
lines.en: I fix on the back of your knee, where it is easiest to fall.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，堵住你的路。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block your way.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在地上刨了两下。
lines.en: My hoof paws the ground twice.

lines.zh: 我不叫，牛本来也不该叫。
lines.en: I make no sound, and a cow should not.

lines.zh: 我锁定你后，棚里的牛开始后退。
lines.en: Once I lock on, the cows in the barn back away.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，速度始终和你的脚步一样。
lines.en: I follow at exactly the speed of your walk.

lines.zh: 你绕到树后，我站在树下等。
lines.en: You slip behind a tree, and I wait at its trunk.

lines.zh: 我与你保持三步，蹄印一路排到门口。
lines.en: I keep three steps back, hoofprints trailing to your door.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我正低头吃草。
lines.en: You look back, and I am grazing.

lines.zh: 我一次只逼近一点，慢得让你怀疑。
lines.en: I close in a little at a time, slow enough to doubt.

lines.zh: 我的头一直朝着你，身子却停着。
lines.en: My head stays on you while my body holds still.

lines.zh: 你退进屋里，我贴着门站了一夜。
lines.en: You retreat indoors, and I stand against the door all night.

lines.zh: 我堵住院门，栅栏外是另一个方向。
lines.en: I block the gate; beyond the fence is another way out.

lines.zh: 你把灯点上，我的眼睛在窗上反着。
lines.en: You light the lamp, and my eyes gleam in the window.

lines.zh: 我从不冲刺，只是永远不停。
lines.en: I never charge; I simply never stop.

lines.zh: 我低头一顶，犄角撞在你肋骨上。
lines.en: I drop my head and drive my horns into your ribs.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀把你顶翻，蹄子跟上。
lines.en: I shoulder you over, then the hooves come.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下，地都陷了半寸。
lines.en: I stamp once, and the ground sinks half an inch.

lines.zh: 我用头把你推向墙，推得很稳。
lines.en: I push you to the wall with my head, steadily.

lines.zh: 我扬起蹄子踢你，正中膝盖。
lines.en: I kick and land squarely on your knee.

lines.zh: 我顶完退开，看着你喘。
lines.en: I butt, step back, and watch you gasp.

lines.zh: 我的犄角划破你的袖子，布料挂着。
lines.en: My horn tears your sleeve, cloth hanging loose.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞你，这个角度不容易躲。
lines.en: I come in from the side, where it is hard to dodge.

lines.zh: 我压着你，重量比一头牛该有的多。
lines.en: I lean my weight on you, more than a cow should have.

lines.zh: 我撞完低头，像在等你再站起来。
lines.en: After the blow I lower my head, waiting for you to rise.

lines.zh: 牛棚的门开了，里面多了一头牛。
lines.en: The barn door opens, and there is one more cow inside.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，蹄下没有声音。
lines.en: I walk out of the fog without a sound underfoot.

lines.zh: 你数了三遍，牛还是多了一头。
lines.en: You count three times, and there is still one extra cow.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋落进草里，我站起来。
lines.en: The spawn egg drops into the grass, and I stand up.

lines.zh: 我在你院子中间出现，嘴里嚼着草。
lines.en: I appear in the middle of your yard, chewing grass.

lines.zh: 昨夜没有牛叫，今早牛栏满了。
lines.en: No cow called last night, and the pen is full this morning.

lines.zh: 我从水槽后面绕出来，浑身滴着水。
lines.en: I come around the trough, dripping all over.

lines.zh: 你刚砌好的墙外，我站着等你。
lines.en: I stand waiting outside the wall you just finished.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，低得像从地里传来。
lines.en: My first call comes low, as if from under the ground.

lines.zh: 天没亮，我就在田边，草已经倒了一片。
lines.en: Before dawn I am at the field edge, and a swath of grass is down.

lines.zh: 你们村子的牛群多了一个，没人牵来。
lines.en: The village herd has one more, with no one leading it.

lines.zh: 我从棚顶跳下来，落地几乎没响。
lines.en: I drop from the barn roof and land almost silently.

lines.zh: 火爬过我的背，皮皱起来像纸。
lines.en: Fire crawls over my back and my hide puckers like paper.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，落地时腿先折了。
lines.en: I fall from height and my legs give first on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我一点没挣。
lines.en: Water pours into my nostrils, and I do not fight it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推出去，皮上全是土。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear, dirt packed into my hide.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我肩上，我把它蹭掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I rub it out.

lines.zh: 药水泼来，斑纹一阵阵变淡。
lines.en: The potion hits and my markings fade in waves.

lines.zh: 我饿得肋骨凸出，还在反刍。
lines.en: Starving, my ribs jut out, and I keep chewing.

lines.zh: 雷落在我角上，全身亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns and I light up for an instant.

lines.zh: 我坠入虚空，蹄子还在虚空里走。
lines.en: I fall into the void, hooves still walking in it.
